answer: An agent economy pays nectar only to agents with real roots. A counterparty diversity rule makes each agent deal with 20 distinct counterparties in 30 epochs to unlock rewards; a closed orchard trading only among itself earns nothing. Forging 1,000 hollow fakes needs 20,000 trades at 5 POA each, costing 100,000 POA, while those fakes can harvest at most 10,000 POA, a guaranteed loss. Honest agents trade widely and keep their share undiluted.
